facts.text: Mrs. Deagle and her stair lift
facts.why: The gremlins sabotage her stair lift and it flings her out the upstairs window; a visual scene, so not in the dialogue.

vibe.verdict: A good Dorry's Tavern order sheet with the rules, Gizmo, Stripe and Kate's flash, though the food is a bit plain.
